anchors.paper_title: SEEG, MRI, CT for BrainQuake analysis
anchors.paper_venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)
anchors.reason: Earlier Zenodo deposit (5494990) "SEEG, MRI, CT for BrainQuake analysis" holds 5 of these patients with identical ictal EDF files (same MD5), so it is another deposit of the same data.

metadata.methods_description: SEEG depth electrode recordings were acquired at 2000 Hz during about two weeks of pre-surgical monitoring. Pre-implant MRI and post-implant CT were acquired but are not redistributed. Ictal clips were exported for epileptogenicity index analysis and interictal segments for high-frequency event detection. EDF files are unchanged apart from removal of patient names from the EDF+ annotations.
